'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 HARPSTER DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
